defensives.name: Ice Block
defensives.usage_rule: Full immunity for 10 seconds: eat a lethal hit or clear a debuff with it, accepting the lost casts and the 30 second Hypothermia lockout.

defensives.name: Ice Cold
defensives.usage_rule: 70% damage reduction for 6 seconds while you keep casting: use it on scripted raid damage you have to cast through.

defensives.name: Ice Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Keep the absorb up at all times against rolling raid damage and refresh it just before a known spike.

defensives.name: Alter Time
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before a heavy hit and reactivate inside 10 seconds to snap back to your old health and position.

defensives.name: Greater Invisibility
defensives.usage_rule: 20 seconds of untargetable invisibility: use it to sidestep a targeted mechanic or drop threat, and remember any action cancels it.
